description: Replacement of non-original timber windows and door to front elevation with traditionally detailed timber double glazed units, including the removal of security bars visible from street level. Installation of Crittall-style windows to rear in place of non-original UPVC doors. Infill of masonry wall to match existing, to reduce glazing to rear of property. Replacement of non-original kitchen. Refurbishment of chimney breast and installation of traditional fireplace. Installation of freestanding joinery units throughout, not disturbingwalls or historic fabric. Installation of metal framed lantern rooflight to rear in place of  non-original UPVC lantern.
site_name: Basement Flat, 26 Lansdowne Crescent, LONDON, W11 2NS
